_comment: PC-keyboard layer: put Ctrl, Super and Alt where a PC keyboard has them. Merged by karabiner/build.sh; keys starting with _ are stripped.

devices._comment: Built-in MacBook keyboard. Karabiner reports it with no vendor/product IDs, so is_keyboard alone matches only it. Swap fn and Ctrl so Ctrl is bottom-left; fn+arrows still gives Home/End/PgUp/PgDn.

Logitech MX Mechanical Mini in Mac mode, where the right-hand Ctrl position sends Option. macOS settings cannot tell left Option from right, so only Karabiner can fix this without breaking Super. For another keyboard, swap in the vendor_id/product_id from Karabiner-EventViewer > Devices.

virtual_hid_keyboard._comment: ANSI, not ISO, is what makes British PC layout come out right through Karabiner. Found by trial.
